description: Improve the clarity and usefulness of worker lifecycle logs by using flow run names instead of IDs, refining error message formats, and separating exit code resolution hints into distinct log entries. These changes will make debugging and monitoring worker operations more intuitive for users.
functional_requirements: Replace flow run IDs with flow run names in all worker log messages for better readability
Update the crashed state error message format to 'Failed to submit flow run to infrastructure: {exc}'
Change the monitoring error message to 'Lost connection to flow run '{name}' infrastructure. The flow run's final state will be determined by the execution environment.'
Emit exit code resolution hints from the exit code registry as separate INFO-level log messages instead of embedding them in error messages
Apply these logging improvements consistently across both submission and monitoring code paths in the worker
